# Skill: run-vitest-unit-tests

**When to use:** Run Angular service and component unit tests under src/app with Vitest from the repository root.

## Scope
- `src/app/**/*.spec.ts`
- `package.json`
- `vitest.config.ts`

## Prerequisites
- Dependencies installed (bun run setup per README.md)
- No separate dev server required for unit tests

## Steps
1. From the repository root, run bun run test to execute the default Vitest suite.
2. Optionally run bun run test:ui for the Vitest UI or bun run test:coverage for coverage output.

## Existing example
- `package.json maps test to vitest; unit specs include src/app/features/article/services/articles.service.spec.ts and src/app/core/auth/services/jwt.service.spec.ts.`
